description:
crate-jmap-chat-client exports significant push-transport surface:

- pub mod ws — `ChatWsExt`, `ChatWsFrame`
- pub mod sse — `ChatSseEvent`, `ChatSseFrame`, `parse_chat_sse_block`
- pub mod session — `ChatSessionExt`, `ChatCapability`, `ChatPushCapability`

The README only lists the typed JMAP method calls — there is no mention of WebSocket or SSE support. For a chat client, push transport is a headline feature.

Fix: add a 'Push transport' section covering both WebSocket (RFC 8887 binding) and Server-Sent Events. Likely warrants a worked example showing how to upgrade a session to WS / start an SSE stream.
title: P2: chat-client README doesn't mention WebSocket or SSE support
